title: Not a good mug
text: Not a good mug. Looks good but it leaks.  I didn't spend much on it, I bought it Meijer, so that's okay.  But the mug leaks on top of lid even if coffee is not full.  When you pick up mug to drink, it seeps from the lid.  I always need to have a napkin underneath to catch any leaks.
